passages.title: Concrete Gaussian representation and unit rows
passages.inference: Actual Gaussian pushforward law proves covariance AAᵀ and almost-sure support in the factor range. The proof uses a possibly singular ambient square factor rather than a rank-dimensional factor. A proved pointwise minimum-threshold merge preserves the affine maximum. This is an explicit equivalent model presentation, with no inverse or spectral floor; no new abstract-Gaussian factor-existence theorem is claimed here.

historical_metadata.inference: The archive works with a possibly singular square factor in the original ambient dimension. The paper chooses a factor on the rank-dimensional support and removes repeated rows by selecting the smallest threshold. A full law/factor instantiation and that exact representation convention remain to be mapped; no concentration conclusion is assumed.

passages.title: Coordinate Gaussian Stein and the intrinsic expected maximum

checked_expanded_types.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.smoothGaussianFaceMaximum_stein
checked_expanded_types.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m] (w : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (a : Fin m → ℝ) (β : ℝ),
  β ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (α : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (w α) = 1) →
      ∀ (ψ dψ : ℝ → ℝ),
        (∀ (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt ψ (dψ t) t) →
          Continuous dψ →
            (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ ψ t ∧ ψ t ≤ 1) →
              ∀ (D : ℝ),
                (∀ (t : ℝ), |dψ t| ≤ D) →
                  ∫ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                      dψ (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.smoothGaussianFaceMaximum w a β x) *
                          RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq
                            (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.smoothGaussianFaceGradient w a β x) +
                        ψ (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.smoothGaussianFaceMaximum w a β x) *
                          ∑ j,
                            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.smoothGaussianFaceHessian w a β x j
                              j ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r =
                    ∫ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                      ψ (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.smoothGaussianFaceMaximum w a β x) *
                        RectangleCLT.faceDot (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.smoothGaussianFaceGradient w a β x)
                          x ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r

The literal convolution route bounds a closed shell, which contains the printed half-open shell; actual level-set nullity is proved.
The general test-function inequality omits the paper’s nondecreasing premise, a valid strengthening; actual convolved ramps are nondecreasing and satisfy all stated bounds.

The public model theorem explicitly assumes the actual pushforward law μ.map V=gaussianLaw A; this is a distributional model input, not an assumed concentration conclusion. All downstream paper applications use genuine concrete Gaussian laws.
